mandatoryCriteria: Session extraction and verification: Valid cookie flowboard_session resolves active session in PostgreSQL and returns actor, owned workspaces, and accessible projects on GET /api/v1/session
Unauthenticated rejection: Missing, invalid, or malformed session cookie returns HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED with standard error envelope
Session expiry: Expired sessions in PostgreSQL are rejected with HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED and access is denied
Session revocation on logout: POST /api/v1/session/logout deletes/revokes the session record in PostgreSQL and clears cookie with Max-Age=0, HttpOnly, Path=/
R1 Audit compliance: Real verified identity required; no unconditional email-only session issuance bypass in production paths
Cookie security attributes: Session cookies set HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax (or Strict), Path=/, and Secure where TLS is active
Workspace and project scoping: Session payload exposes only actor-owned workspaces and explicit project grants, with zero leakage of ungranted sibling projects
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Session store adapter, auth middleware, session routes (GET /session, POST /session/logout, dev-login), cookie handling, and PostgreSQL session lifecycle across Node and Cloudflare Worker runtimes. Out-of-scope: Third-party OAuth hosted redirects and credentials (Google/GitHub) are deferred to hosted identity tasks.
